title: Equivariant Floer cohomology for contactomorphisms of quotient spaces
summary: This paper establishes the orderability of contact manifolds which are quotients of fillable contact manifolds under finite group actions compatible with the filling, the prototypical example being $\mathbb{R}P^{2n-1}$ as the quotient of $S^{2n-1}$. Our approach employs an equivariant formulation of the so-called contact Floer cohomology theory. This leads us to develop an analogue of Givental's nonlinear Maslov index using the $\mathbf{k}[[x]]$-module structure on an equivariant version of contact Floer cohomology.
